items.title: AI’s boost to the U.S. economy is nearing its peak, Goldman says, as Apollo finds ‘zero financial payoff’ outside Big Tech
items.summary: Apollo’s Torsten Slok rocked Wall Street with his take that AI returns just aren't there, then Goldman’s Jan Hatzius flagged two major downsides to growth.
items.titleZh: 高盛表示，人工智能对美国经济的推动正接近顶峰，因为阿波罗在大型科技公司之外发现了“零财务回报”
items.summaryZh: 阿波罗的托斯滕·斯洛克（Torsten Slok）认为人工智能的回报根本不存在，这震惊了华尔街，然后高盛的简·哈祖斯（Jan Hatzius）指出了增长的两大不利因素。

items.title: Elizabeth Holmes insists she never lied. A deception expert says ‘You Can See Everything’ hinges on one tiny word
items.summary: A University of Puget Sound professor who studies deception says Holmes may have mastered “paltering,” using true statements to create false impressions. Nathan Fielder’s hit documentary can’t settle whether she knows she’s doing it.
items.titleZh: 伊丽莎白·霍姆斯坚称她从未撒谎。一位欺骗专家说，“你可以看到一切”取决于一个小词
items.summaryZh: 普吉特海湾大学一位研究欺骗行为的教授说，福尔摩斯可能已经掌握了“打招呼”，用真实的陈述来制造虚假的印象。Nathan Fielder的热门纪录片无法确定她是否知道自己在做这件事。
